# Premier Inc

> > Premier Inc is a healthcare improvement company providing supply chain solutions, data analytics, and real-world evidence through the Premier Healthcare Database to hospitals, health systems, and life sciences organizations.

Premier Inc serves healthcare providers with group purchasing, performance improvement programs like the 100 Top Hospitals, and clinical research capabilities. The company leverages AI, predictive analytics, and real-world data to drive value-based care, optimize supply chains, and support pharmaceutical research.

## Key Topics

- Premier Healthcare Database
- Real-world evidence
- Supply chain management
- AI governance and predictive analytics
- Value-driven care
- Clinical trials and life sciences
- Drug shortages and pharmacy strategy
- Workforce management
- Digital health and AI-enabled stewardship
- 100 Top Hospitals Program
- Healthcare trends 2026
- S2S Global
- Post-acute care
- Patient Square Capital acquisition
